_about: Independently hand-calculated expected results for reconciliation.integration.test.ts (docs/UTILITIES_BILLING_RECONCILIATION.md). FICTIONAL tariffs. Amounts in cents. VAT 15 %, rounded half-up per line. Written BEFORE running the engine; never edited to match it.

tariffs.E_EXCL: electricity, property-wide: flat R2.50/kWh EXCL VAT + R50.00/month fixed EXCL VAT
tariffs.W_BLOCK: water, property-wide: blocks 0-6 kL R20, 6-15 kL R30, >15 kL R50 per kL, INCL VAT, no fixed
tariffs.E_R4_A: electricity, unit R4 only: flat R3.00/kWh INCL, effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-15
tariffs.E_R4_B: electricity, unit R4 only: flat R3.30/kWh INCL, effective from 2026-10-16
tariffs.E_SEASON: electricity, property 2 (July): default R2.00/kWh INCL; Winter (Jun-Aug) R4.00/kWh INCL
